name: XGrammar
summary: Fast portable structured-generation engine for LLM grammars and constrained decoding (MLC AI).
description: Apache-2.0 structured-generation engine (mlc-ai/xgrammar; not archived). PyPI xgrammar 0.2.8 verified 2026-11-09. Docs at https://xgrammar.mlc.ai/. Designed for flexible grammar-constrained generation across backends. Model and runtime costs are separate.

agent_access.notes: Install via pip install xgrammar; integrate with supported inference stacks.
